verses.he: וַיֹּ֣סֶף אִ֭יּוֹב שְׂאֵ֥ת מְשָׁל֗וֹ וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: And Job again took up his parable, and said:

verses.he: מִֽי־יִתְּנֵ֥נִי כְיַרְחֵי־קֶ֑דֶם כִּ֝ימֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יִשְׁמְרֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Oh that I were as in the months of old, As in the days when God watched over me;

verses.he: בְּהִלּ֣וֹ נֵ֭רוֹ עֲלֵ֣י רֹאשִׁ֑י לְ֝אוֹרוֹ אֵ֣לֶךְ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.en: When His lamp shined above my head, And by His light I walked through darkness;

verses.he: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר הָ֭יִיתִי בִּימֵ֣י חָרְפִּ֑י בְּס֥וֹד אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ עֲלֵ֣י אָהֳלִֽי׃
verses.en: As I was in the days of my youth, When the converse of God was upon my tent;

verses.he: בְּע֣וֹד שַׁ֭דַּי עִמָּדִ֑י סְבִ֖יבוֹתַ֣י נְעָרָֽי׃
verses.en: When the Almighty was yet with me, And my children were about me;

verses.he: בִּרְחֹ֣ץ הֲלִיכַ֣י בְּחֵמָ֑ה וְצ֥וּר יָצ֥וּק עִ֝מָּדִ֗י פַּלְגֵי־שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.en: When my steps were washed with butter, And the rock poured me out rivers of oil!

verses.he: בְּצֵ֣אתִי שַׁ֣עַר עֲלֵי־קָ֑רֶת בָּ֝רְח֗וֹב אָכִ֥ין מוֹשָׁבִֽי׃
verses.en: When I went forth to the gate unto the city, When I prepared my seat in the broad place,

verses.he: רָא֣וּנִי נְעָרִ֣ים וְנֶחְבָּ֑אוּ וִֽ֝ישִׁישִׁים קָ֣מוּ עָמָֽדוּ׃
verses.en: The young men saw me and hid themselves, And the aged rose up and stood;

verses.he: שָׂ֭רִים עָצְר֣וּ בְמִלִּ֑ים וְ֝כַ֗ף יָשִׂ֥ימוּ לְפִיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: The princes refrained talking, And laid their hand on their mouth;

verses.he: קוֹל־נְגִידִ֥ים נֶחְבָּ֑אוּ וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם לְחִכָּ֥ם דָּבֵֽקָה׃
verses.en: The voice of the nobles was hushed, And their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.

verses.he: כִּ֤י אֹ֣זֶן שָׁ֭מְעָה וַֽתְּאַשְּׁרֵ֑נִי וְעַ֥יִן רָ֝אֲתָ֗ה וַתְּעִידֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, And when the eye saw me, it gave witness unto me;

verses.he: כִּֽי־אֲ֭מַלֵּט עָנִ֣י מְשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וְ֝יָת֗וֹם וְֽלֹא־עֹזֵ֥ר לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Because I delivered the poor that cried, The fatherless also, that had none to help him.

verses.he: בִּרְכַּ֣ת אֹ֭בֵד עָלַ֣י תָּבֹ֑א וְלֵ֖ב אַלְמָנָ֣ה אַרְנִֽן׃
verses.en: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me; and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

verses.he: צֶ֣דֶק לָ֭בַשְׁתִּי וַיִּלְבָּשֵׁ֑נִי כִּמְעִ֥יל וְ֝צָנִ֗יף מִשְׁפָּטִֽי׃
verses.en: I put on righteousness, and it clothed itself with me; My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

verses.he: עֵינַ֣יִם הָ֭יִיתִי לַֽעִוֵּ֑ר וְרַגְלַ֖יִם לַפִּסֵּ֣חַ אָֽנִי׃
verses.en: I was eyes to the blind, And feet was I to the lame.

verses.he: אָ֣ב אָ֭נֹכִֽי לָֽאֶבְיוֹנִ֑ים וְרִ֖ב לֹא־יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶחְקְרֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: I was a father to the needy; And the cause of him that I knew not I searched out.

verses.he: וָֽ֭אֲשַׁבְּרָה מְתַלְּע֣וֹת עַוָּ֑ל וּ֝מִשִּׁנָּ֗יו אַשְׁלִ֥יךְ טָֽרֶף׃
verses.en: And I broke the jaws of the unrighteous, And plucked the prey out of his teeth.

verses.he: וָ֭אֹמַר עִם־קִנִּ֣י אֶגְוָ֑ע וְ֝כַח֗וֹל אַרְבֶּ֥ה יָמִֽים׃
verses.en: Then I said: ‘I shall die with my nest, And I shall multiply my days as the phoenix;

verses.he: שָׁרְשִׁ֣י פָת֣וּחַ אֱלֵי־מָ֑יִם וְ֝טַ֗ל יָלִ֥ין בִּקְצִירִֽי׃
verses.en: My root shall be spread out to the waters, And the dew shall lie all night upon my branch;

verses.he: כְּ֭בוֹדִי חָדָ֣שׁ עִמָּדִ֑י וְ֝קַשְׁתִּ֗י בְּיָדִ֥י תַחֲלִֽיף׃
verses.en: My glory shall be fresh in me, And my bow shall be renewed in my hand.’

verses.he: לִֽי־שָׁמְע֥וּ וְיִחֵ֑לּוּ וְ֝יִדְּמ֗וּ לְמ֣וֹ עֲצָתִֽי׃
verses.en: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, And kept silence for my counsel.

verses.he: אַחֲרֵ֣י דְ֭בָרִי לֹ֣א יִשְׁנ֑וּ וְ֝עָלֵ֗ימוֹ תִּטֹּ֥ף מִלָּתִֽי׃
verses.en: After my words they spoke not again; And my speech dropped upon them.

verses.he: וְיִֽחֲל֣וּ כַמָּטָ֣ר לִ֑י וּ֝פִיהֶ֗ם פָּעֲר֥וּ לְמַלְקֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.en: And they waited for me as for the rain; And they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.

verses.he: אֶשְׂחַ֣ק אֲ֭לֵהֶם לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ינוּ וְא֥וֹר פָּ֝נַ֗י לֹ֣א יַפִּילֽוּן׃
verses.en: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; And the light of my countenance they cast not down.

verses.he: אֶֽבֲחַ֣ר דַּרְכָּם֮ וְאֵשֵׁ֪ב רֹ֥אשׁ וְ֭אֶשְׁכּוֹן כְּמֶ֣לֶךְ בַּגְּד֑וּד כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲבֵלִ֣ים יְנַחֵֽם׃
verses.en: I chose out their way, and sat as chief, And dwelt as a king in the army, As one that comforteth the mourners.
